title: Leadership & Teams

vocab.pt: Pessoa que trabalha bem em equipe

expressions.example: The manager made the team stay late.
She let her team choose the project.
He had his assistant prepare the report.

expressions.expr: to get someone to do something
expressions.example: She got the team to meet the deadline.

sentences: The manager made the team work overtime.
She let her employees choose their own projects.
He had his assistant prepare the presentation.
I got the team to finish the report early.
She made her team feel valued and motivated.
The leader let the interns present their ideas.
He had the whole team review the proposal.
We got everyone to agree on the deadline.

grammar.title: Make, Let, Have + Someone Do Something
rules: "make + pessoa + verbo base" indica obrigar alguém a fazer algo: She made him rewrite the report.
"let + pessoa + verbo base" indica permitir: She let her team leave early.
"have + pessoa + verbo base" indica mandar ou pedir a alguém para fazer algo: He had his assistant call the client.
"get + pessoa + to + verbo" indica persuadir/conseguir que alguém faça algo: She got the team to work together.

rows: She made the team work late.
He let her lead the meeting.
He had his assistant send the email.
She got the team to meet the deadline.
